description:
What Foundry's own server-side trace (Application Insights) says about one attempt.

Joined after the run, because spans take minutes to appear. It is a cross-check on the stream:
the tool span reports success even when the call failed, so the agent span is the signal.

trace_id.description: Application Insights operation id for the whole invocation
trace_id.title: Trace Id

error_type.description: Foundry's error.type on the agent span, e.g. tool_user_error
error_type.title: Error Type

agent_span_s.description: Server-side duration of the agent invocation
agent_span_s.title: Agent Span S

tool_time_s.description: Server-side execution time of the tool calls from the trace; the stream cannot show it
tool_time_s.title: Tool Time S

tool_span_s.description: Duration of each tool span, in call order
tool_span_s.title: Tool Span S

tool_error.description: The trace shows a tool error: error.type starts with tool, or a tool span failed
tool_error.title: Tool Error

model_spans.description: Model-call (chat) spans; Foundry may not emit one for every model call
model_spans.title: Model Spans

model_time_s.description: Wall time covered by the model-call spans
model_time_s.title: Model Time S

untraced_s.description: Agent span time covered by no tool or model span: orchestration and untraced model calls
untraced_s.title: Untraced S

model_cache_read_tokens.description: Prompt-cache hits from the trace; the Responses API usage reports 0 here
model_cache_read_tokens.title: Model Cache Read Tokens

spans.description: Tool and model-call spans in start order: kind, name, start_s (from agent start), duration_s, success, and token counts for model calls
spans.title: Spans

title: TraceRecord
